description: This is a React frontend component called ControlsPage that provides UI for controlling smart light devices. It manages device selection, toggling power, changing color via a color picker, and adjusting brightness, fetching and updating data via API calls.

methods.name: setLight
methods.description: Toggles the light on or off based on user input, updating the status accordingly.

methods.name: submitColor
methods.description: Submits a new color for the device, updating the color state.

methods.name: submitBrightness
methods.description: Updates the device brightness setting based on user input.
